note: Structural inventory of the 19 kask crates under kask/crates/ (18 hkask-* + kask_bridge) and their lib roots. This is NOT a D-seam inventory — the D1–D18 integration seams are documented in DIVERGENCE.md. This inventory also excludes the 11 MCP server crates (kask/mcp-servers/) and the zed-side crates (crates/kask_extensions_ui/, crates/swarm_panel/, and the viz widget crates under crates/hkask-*-widget/). A full public-API surface enumeration (pub fn/struct/enum/trait/const/type counts per crate, with coverage by tests) requires an API-extraction tool that is not yet wired. The totals below are therefore 0 — they are placeholders until that tool runs. The `crates` map is populated with the lib root path and description for each crate so a future pass has the entry points.

hkask-bridge-ontology.description: Ontology bridge — Dublin Core + BIBO + CiTO + PKO core vocabulary and domain supplements (FIBO, ESO, GOLEM, OMC, ML-Schema). Single source of truth for ontology URIs, the dual-axis domain-selection logic, the unified ontology tag shape, and the explain_tool_for dispatch function (the I pattern).

hkask-capability.description: Tool dispatch port (ToolPort, ToolInfo, ToolFuture, ToolPortError) plus the SYSTEM_MAX_RECURSION cascade bound. Holds no capability tokens, no authorization check, and no information-flow labels: the Ed25519 token ceremony was removed 2026-07-31, the per-call DelegationToken capability gate on 2026-08-12 (RR-0056), and the FIDES taint lattice (ToolTaint, can_flow_to, ToolInfo.taint, src/tool_taint.rs) on 2026-08-12 (RR-0053) because every tool was hardcoded Pure so the Source->Sink block could not fire

hkask-condenser.description: Context condensation domain logic — compression algorithms, classification, profile management, and inference formatting

hkask-email.description: Curator email (MXroute SMTP API outbound + IMAP inbound + algedonic alert email sink)

hkask-forecast.description: Shared superforecasting computation engine — Fermi decomposition, outside/inside view, Bayesian updating, Brier scoring

hkask-goal.description: DELETED in the 2026-07-25 cleanup — `GoalState` retained in `hkask-types`; `Goal`/`GoalArtifact`/`GoalCriterion` removed. This entry is retained as a tombstone; the crate directory no longer exists.

hkask-lisp.description: Sandboxed Lisp interpreter for deterministic manifest compute steps (lisp.eval) — no I/O, no fs, no network, no env. Used by hkask-templates executor compute action.

hkask-guard.description: hKask content safety guard — mandatory input/output scanning for all LLM boundaries, OWASP LLM Top 10 aligned

hkask-inference.description: Multi-provider inference router for hKask — DeepInfra, fal.ai, OpenRouter

hkask-keystore.description: OS keychain integration and AES-256-GCM encryption for hKask

hkask-ledger.description: Double-entry accounting ledger — immutable transactions for cost, crypto, and securities tracking

hkask-mcp-server.description: MCP server utilities and the `run_server` factory for hKask MCP servers (daemon transport and `bootstrap_mcp_server` were deleted in the 2026-07-25 cleanup).

hkask-mcp.description: MCP runtime and governance for hKask

hkask-memory.description: Semantic and episodic memory pipelines for hKask

hkask-regulation.description: Cybernetic Nervous System for hKask. The runtime_policy module (DefaultPolicy, PolicyVerdict, PolicyConfig) was deleted 2026-08-12 (RR-0053) along with the hkask-capability dependency it needed for taint labels; defense Layer 5 (information flow control) is absent by decision, as Layer 3 is under RR-0010

hkask-services-core.description: hKask service-layer foundation — ServiceError, ServiceConfig, HkaskSettings

hkask-templates.description: Registry, vocabulary, and template execution for hKask

hkask-types.description: ID types, nu-event, and visibility types for hKask

kask_bridge.description: The bidirectional seam between hKask port traits and zed-kask facilities (D8)
